name: academic-two-voices
idea: Two accent colours for two voices: evidence (what the paper or data shows) and critique (what the presenter thinks). Everything else stays ink and grey.

contrastOnBackground.note: WCAG contrast ratios against color.background; rule and dataNeutral are for lines and de-emphasised data, not text.

usage.evidence: Only the data series, number or figure border currently being discussed. At most one use per slide.
usage.critique: Only the presenter's own judgement: annotations, doubts, limitations, proposed fixes. At most one use per slide.
usage.tints: Background of a callout box in the matching voice; text on a tint stays ink.
